verdict.rationale: Retell ships Conductor, a first-party AI assistant that takes plain-language requests across most of the product. It can draft agents from a description, edit prompts, settings and flows, run simulation tests, investigate calls and chats, and build analytics dashboards. It can also inspect knowledge bases, AI QA results and contacts, proposing changes for review before applying them. An official MCP server adds natural-language operation from Claude, Cursor and similar clients. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Conductor's natural-language operation, and evidence that phone-number and telephony management is covered by natural-language commands.
